spec.claim_summary: Bitcoin dropping below its 200-week moving average is a buying opportunity, exemplified by the March 2020 dip.

claimed.other: Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today

assumptions: Timeframe chosen as 1d from page chart timeframe; 200-week average converted to 1400-day SMA (200*7) because schema only allows 1h/4h/1d.
Entry compiled as close crosses_below 1400-day SMA to represent 'price drops below this threshold' as a repeatable trigger.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: one-time lump-sum sizing ($10,000) and hold-to-today portfolio valuation; engine tests repeated signals starting flat one position at a time.
No exit stated so max_hold_bars 1460 (~4 years March 2020 to July 2024) assumed to represent buy-and-hold until 'today'.

evidence.quote: price falls below its 200-week moving average
Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today
